author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing had no aerial silk at all, and its bent-knee crouch read as someone dancing or falling. Redrawn to the reference pose: one straight line runs from the stretched back foot through the hip to the shoulder, the other leg stands under the hip, and the arm reaches out to grip a silk hanging from the ceiling at the right.
omissions: The silk's second fabric line is left out; one hanging line stands for it.
